title: Presence cache Observe notifies on identical record()
description:
PresenceCacheResource.record always calls updated_state() after writing _nodes[addr], even when addr/status/battery/ts are unchanged. PresenceResource.set_presence returns early on equality.

Duplicate LoRa beacons or re-records of the same sample re-notify every Observe subscriber with a full cache snapshot. That is extra airtime and client work for a no-op.

File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/presence.py record() (approx 203-224)
Compare: PresenceResource.set_presence (approx 68-76)
acceptance_criteria: record() with the same addr, status, battery, and ts does not call updated_state(). A real field or ts change still notifies. Test covers no-op vs change.
